description: This file defines the 'Product' entity class in a Java-based e-commerce application. It maps to the 'PRODUCT' table in the database and includes fields for product details such as SKU, descriptions, images, categories, manufacturer, pricing, availability, and relationships with other entities.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity class representing a product in the catalog, with fields for product details, relationships, and metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with the product.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the product.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: getProductLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the product.

methods.name: setProductLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the product.

methods.name: getProductWidth

methods.name: setProductWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the product.

methods.name: setProductHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the product.

methods.name: getProductWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the product.

methods.name: setProductWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the product.

methods.name: getProductReviewAvg
methods.description: Returns the average review score for the product.

methods.name: setProductReviewAvg

methods.name: getProductReviewCount

methods.name: getProductOrdered

methods.name: setSku

methods.name: getDescriptions

methods.name: setDescriptions

methods.name: getProductVirtual

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.

methods.name: getProductIsFree
methods.description: Checks if the product is free.

methods.name: setProductIsFree

methods.description: Returns the set of product attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the product attributes.

methods.name: getManufacturer

methods.name: getRelationships

methods.name: setRelationships

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the categories for the product.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the product.

methods.name: setMerchantStore

methods.name: getProductImage
